title: NarrativeDecodeResult
description: Deterministic, non-evaluative output contract emitted by lumei-star-l-decoder.

episode_scope.description: Bounded title or description of the specific work episode examined.

verbatim.description: Direct quotes from the narrator or documented dialogues.

observable_actions.description: Explicit actions, choices, coordinations, or boundaries set.

documented_outputs.description: Tangible artifacts, emails, memos, slides, or tickets produced.

reported_claims.description: Subjective claims or unverified outcome assertions made by narrator.

perspective.description: Stated decision frame, problem, or perspective. Null if unsupported.

situation.description: Context, constraints, actors, timing, stakes. Null if unsupported.

task.description: Explicit mandate, responsibility, or intended outcome. Null if unsupported.

results.description: Reported or verified consequences, feedback, and side-effects.

learning_stated.description: Learning explicitly articulated by narrator. Null if absent.

learning_interpretation.description: Alternative or systemic learning interpretation grounded in evidence. Null if unwarranted.

unknowns.description: Material variables or context absent from the narrative.

contradictions.description: Tensions or contradictions preserved between actions, results, and stated learning.

alternative_explanation.description: At least one plausible alternative mechanism explaining the result without assuming user causality.

friction_signal.description: Assessment of authentic cognitive scar tissue / skin-in-the-game tension.

clarity_created.description: Observable evidence of clarifying boundaries or priorities.

dissent_enabled.description: Observable evidence of inviting missing information or counter-perspectives.

pressure_amplified.description: Observable evidence of rushing commitments or narrowing participation.

prohibited.description: Explicit manifest of prohibited analytical entities.
